Data.title: Resident Population Aged 5 Years and Over in Resident Households by Living Arrangement, Level of Difficulty in Performing Basic Activities, Age Group and Sex
Data.footnote: Notes: For residents aged 5 years and over in resident households, the Living Arrangement categories are based on presence of their spouse, children (including children-in-law), and/or parents (including parents-in-law) in the same household.
